hero.summary: Detail-oriented SQA Engineer experienced in manual and automation testing of web applications. I design and execute test cases, build automation suites with Python and Playwright, and turn defects into clear, actionable bug reports.

about.heading: Quality is a habit, not a phase
paragraphs: I'm a Junior SQA Engineer at Octopi-Digital Limited, where I test OptimalMD and several in-house products. My work spans functional, regression and exploratory testing, plus Playwright automation for the OptimalMD staging platform.
Before that I tested web and mobile apps at Join Venture AI and QA Harbor, covering API testing with Postman, performance testing with JMeter and Selenium automation inside Agile teams.
I graduated in Computer Science and Engineering from Green University of Bangladesh with a 3.84 CGPA, and have co-authored research on carbon-neutral edge computing published at IEEE SMC 2025.

bullets: Perform manual testing across OptimalMD and multiple in-house projects, covering functional, regression and exploratory testing to ensure application quality and usability.
Design, develop and execute automated test scripts for the OptimalMD staging platform using Python and Playwright.
Identify, document and track defects in Linear, writing detailed bug reports and working with developers through to resolution.
Performed manual and automation testing of web and mobile applications using Playwright, designing and executing functional, regression and cross-platform test cases.
Conducted API testing with Postman and performance testing with Apache JMeter to evaluate functionality, reliability and performance.
Analyzed business requirements and technical specifications to prepare test documentation, and collaborated with developers and cross-functional teams in Agile sprints.
Supported manual testing of web and mobile applications by designing and executing test scenarios.
Assisted in Selenium automation setup and participated in security testing activities.
Collaborated within Agile teams using SDLC and STLC practices to identify defects and improve application quality.

projects.title: OptimalMD Member Portal – Test Automation Suite
projects.description: Playwright + pytest suite (Page Object Model) for a healthcare portal covering registration, Stripe payments, email/OTP verification over IMAP, profile activation, dashboard services and dependents. Runs 30+ tests in under 5 minutes, with a custom Flask runner that shows a live browser view and step-by-step results.

projects.title: Advantage Shopping Test Suite
projects.description: Manual and automated testing of the Advantage Shopping web app using Playwright with Python. Designed and executed test cases to validate functionality, find bugs and check cross-browser compatibility.

projects.title: Restful-booker API (API Testing)
projects.description: Automated authentication and booking CRUD workflows in Postman with dynamic variables, pre/post scripts and response assertions. Ran collections with Newman to generate HTML test reports.

projects.title: Restful-booker API (Performance Testing)
projects.description: Load test scenarios in Apache JMeter with assertions and pre/post-processors for dynamic data. Executed via CLI and generated HTML reports to analyze response time, throughput and system performance.

projects.title: LuxuryOps Web Application
projects.description: End-to-end manual testing focused on UI/UX and usability. Documented bugs in a structured report highlighting user experience inconsistencies.

projects.title: Space Express Web Application
projects.description: End-to-end manual testing of core functional workflows. Analyzed business requirement documents and built a structured feature list to support requirement tracking and test planning.

projects.title: Quran Mobile App
projects.description: End-to-end functional testing of a mobile/web app: validated core features, reported defects with clear reproduction steps and tracked them through requirement-based test execution.
